Nudge cloud-a down/right or scale it to ~0.9; lint flags it clipped at the top-left safe-area edge.
Shift coins-a right or scale to ~0.85 so the stack stops bleeding past the left safe-area edge per lint.
Raise chart-ground (or scale it to ~0.6) — the opaque white panel currently clips both investors off at the waist, hiding their legs.
Right half reads empty (bare cream around the dashed rocket) against a crowded left half; scale bldg-b/rocket-b group to ~1.1 or bring the dashed outline closer to balance the frame.
Stagger the coins diagonally toward the cloud instead of a straight vertical column beside the building, so the 'money ladder' metaphor connects visually rather than floating disconnected.

review.verdict: The core contrast — one company climbing a coin-ladder into the clouds versus a rival's rocket shrinking on the pad — reads quickly and the cast is correctly human/institution, but overlapping investor figures, an ambiguous price-tag prop, and a cramped chart keep it from feeling fully polished. It clears the pass bar, just barely.

Redesign the tag-tall/tag-short raw props so the colored box reads as a price tag rather than an antenna or thermometer — add a tag-notch silhouette or a small numeral so the 'valuation signal' mechanic is legible without the caption.
Scale chart-small up to ~0.55 and nudge to y=0.92, clear of the investors' legs, so the falling-arrow chart isn't the smallest, least legible element in the frame.
